name: Choice card
description: A card-sized radio or checkbox for choices that need a sentence or a price: plans, delivery options, add-ons, and compact cards for time slots and sizes. The whole card is the label of a native input.

classes.ayy-choice-group: Grid of cards that adapts to its box (cards at least --ayy-min wide, default 12rem, 6rem for compact cards). Usually a <fieldset>, role="radiogroup" for radio cards.
classes.ayy-choice-group--scroll: One row that scrolls sideways instead of wrapping: a day strip, sizes on a phone. Cards stay at least --ayy-min wide.
classes.ayy-choice-group__legend: The group's question, as the fieldset's <legend>.
classes.ayy-choice-card: A <label> card around a native <input class="ayy-radio"> or ayy-checkbox, drawn in the inline-end corner. Chosen: a text-colour border, 2px.
classes.ayy-choice-card--compact: A time slot or a size: centred text, input hidden, filled when chosen; a disabled one is struck through.
classes.ayy-choice-card__meta: A price or a date, at the bottom so a row of cards lines them up.

default.looks: Surface card with a line border and card radius; the radio or checkbox sits in the inline-end corner. Compact: centred label, input hidden.

pressed.none: No pressed look; it picks on release.

focus.looks: 2px ring around the whole card, 2px offset.

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, not-allowed cursor; a compact slot's title is struck through too.

selected.looks: Text-colour border plus a 1px ring (reads as 2px without moving anything). Compact fills with the text colour, label in the page colour. Forced colours: Highlight outline or fill.

error.when: aria-invalid="true" on the inputs, with a FieldError under the group
error.looks: The inputs draw their red borders (Radio, Checkbox); compact cards show only the FieldError.

loading.none: Load the options before showing them; use Skeletons in the cards' shape meanwhile.

sizes.density: Card padding is fixed; the corner input follows --ayy-size-check. Compact cards are at least the lg control height.
sizes.width: The group is a grid of columns at least --ayy-min wide (12rem, 6rem for compact) that fills its box; scroll makes one sideways row.

js: choiceCardClass({ compact?, className? }), choiceGroupClass({ scroll?, className? }) → string; choiceGroupLegendClass, choiceCardTitleClass, choiceCardDescriptionClass, choiceCardMetaClass constants.

props.type: "radio" (one choice, kept by the group) | "checkbox" (cards that combine)
props.name: Shared radio name. Generated if omitted.
props.scroll: boolean — one row that scrolls sideways

props.title: ReactNode
props.icon: ReactNode — an Icon or Icon tile above the title
props.inputProps: Props for the native input (name for checkbox cards).

a11y: Each card is a native radio or checkbox labelled by the whole card: Space picks it, arrow keys move between radios, and the title, description and price are its name.
Group them in a <fieldset> with a <legend> (ChoiceGroup legend) so the question is announced with each option.
Chosen is a thicker border (and a filled card when compact), not colour alone; High Contrast outlines it with the system highlight.
A full slot stays in the group as disabled, struck through, so people see what isn't available.
do: Use choice cards when each option needs more than a word: a plan with its price, a delivery option with its date, an add-on with what it costs.
Use compact cards for a grid of short options: time slots, sizes, seat counts. Say what's left in the description. A day strip is compact cards in a scroll group.
Mark the recommended plan with a Badge in its title; the chosen state is the border.
Use type checkbox for add-ons that combine, radio for one choice.
dont: Don't use choice cards for a yes/no setting — use Switch; for two to five short words, use a Segmented control; for a long list, use Select.
Don't put links or buttons inside a card: the whole card is the label.
Don't use them to show plans you can't pick (a marketing pricing table) — use Cards with Card featured.
